title: Future GPX Cyber Formula's New Anime Short Reveals Cast, Staff, Screening on February 19
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Saturday that its planned new anime short for the Future GPX Cyber Formula series will screen alongside a new HD remastered "movie edition" of the Future GPX Cyber Formula: Early Days Renewal compilation OVA in Japan starting on February 19, 2027.

title: The Fake Alchemist Reveals First PV and Key Production Details
content: The production committee for The Fake Alchemist ( Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi )has released a promotional video and announced the anime’s cast and staff. Miyari Nemoto and Youhei Matsuoka will voice the leads, Nora and Paracelsus, respectively.

title: Every Anime Coming to Netflix in October 2026
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and all major platforms are planning to release new shows for fans across the globe. Crunchyroll by far has the largest lineup, just like every other season. The platform always releases almost all of the new seasonal shows, and this time is no different.

title: 35 Years Later, There’s Still No Beating Anime’s Wildest Action Series Ever
content: It’s been 35 years since the legendary and wildest action series Baki the Grappler debuted in Akita Shoten’s Weekly Shonen Champion magazine. Written and illustrated by Keisuke Itagaki, the manga made its mark in history for all the right and wrong reasons.
author: ComicBook

title: 20 Years Later, This Dark Action Fantasy Is Still a Hit With Anime Fans (For Good Reason)
content: Dark fantasy anime and manga have often ranked among some of the most beloved series of all time, especially when there’s a bit of action blended into the story. Over the years, dark fantasy has had quite a hold in the industry, as evidenced by the explosive popularity of Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer .

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Game Streams Opening Cinematic
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming a 16-minute opening cinematic trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve , the newest game in its Ace Combat modern air combat franchise , on Thursday. The game will launch on October 2 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
